content:
Based on the provided context, specifically under the section "REMOTE WORK EXPENSES AND PROFESSIONAL EXPENSES," the minimum payment that GitLab France S.A.S. will cover for remote work expenses (such as wifi, heating, and electricity) is **€57.20 per month**.

This payment is subject to the condition that the team member's actual monthly remote work expenses reach at least this amount and are substantiated by appropriate receipts.
